title: Chapter 97: First Kill Of Bronze Boss
content:
Chapter 97: First Kill Of Bronze Boss

Wang Shuo and others were unable to dodge and were immediately stabbed by a small number of feathers, all of whom were seriously injured.

Only Ayub and Gong Zheng, relying on their golden armor, almost did not lose blood.

And Gong Ping, who was in close combat, was the most seriously injured.

However, as long as he was not dead, it was not a big problem.

Wang Shuo immediately used "Flame Breath".

Killed in one move.

[You killed 1ss, ID: Eagle 00136 Gusun, reward all attributes +1. ]

Moreover, this flying boss exploded a large number of items, which made Wang Shuo's eyes light up.

[Agility Enhancement Pill +5, Spy Job Transfer Certificate +5, Soul Crystal +3, Energy Crystal +90]

[Agility Enhancement Pill: After taking it, agility is increased by 5 points, and each person is limited to taking 1 pill. ]

[Spy Job Transfer Certificate: Hidden profession, after use, you can transform into a spy, hide your own territory attributes, and disguise your loyalty. ]

After seeing this, Wang Shuo's heart jumped. There is such a hidden profession?

He couldn't help but worry about whether there were spies in his territory. It seemed that he had to be more careful in the future.

Looking at the proof in his hand, a barely detectable smile appeared on the corner of his mouth. Arranging a few spies for other forces, this idea might be interesting!

Lord Zach, you are quite thoughtful.

Killed this flying boss. Wang Shuo breathed a sigh of relief.

He stood on the high platform and observed the entire battlefield.

An abrupt black spot in the distance caught his attention.

Because the distance was too far, he took out the telescope.

I saw several huge wild monsters standing on several small hills in the distance.

It's obvious that they are bosses.

There are at least 10 of them. Because the distance is too far, it is impossible to detect specific information.

One of them is as big as a hill.

Wang Shuo's pupils suddenly shrank, his lips turned purple, and his face was pale.

For a moment, he even forgot to breathe.

Moreover, he even felt a chill that rushed straight to his head in an instant, and the whole person felt like falling into an ice cave.

This...

Are you kidding me?

Can we still defend this?

Wang Shuo suddenly lost confidence.

Red Panda: "Brothers, are there any bosses among the beasts besieging your village?"

Northeast Tiger: "No, there are only more than 200,000 black beetles, including several elite monsters. This is too much of a disdain for me! I prepared a lot of defensive supplies, but before I could even exert my strength, these black beetles were destroyed. It's a bit uncomfortable, like my pants were taken off and I was shown this?"

Skateboard Shoes: "Don't make sarcastic remarks upstairs. Do you think this is fun? I encountered a bronze boss and more than 20 people died. Let me cry silently for a while, o(╥﹏╥)o"

After waiting for a long time, two lords replied to him.

At the same time, he noticed that the number of lords in the "Village Leader Group" has dropped from 5,000 at the beginning to 2,100, and half of the lords have been eliminated directly.

Wang Shuo thought about it, and it seemed that there was another lord among his friends.

"Zhang Yang, how are you now? Have you met the boss?"

After a while, seeing that the other party did not reply, Wang Shuo planned to defend the city wall first.

Just then, Zhang Yang sent a message, and it was a voice message.

"Hey, brother, you still have time to chat!"

"I have 2 bronze bosses and 1 silver boss here, the situation is extremely critical!"

"I have killed the bronze boss!"

The voice was a little intermittent, and the roar of the beast could be heard from time to time.

"No more, I'm going to kill the silver boss."

"If, I mean if, I die in battle, if there is a chance, you take care of Wang Yuyao!"

The other party's tone was very urgent, and it seemed that they were fighting fiercely.

In this extremely urgent situation, the other party returned his message, and Wang Shuo was still a little touched!

However, seeing the last sentence, he probably replied to his message for Wang Yuyao!

Wang Shuo thought for a while before he remembered Wang Yuyao.

She seemed to be the girl who brought him hot water during the novice trial!

At this moment, Wang Shuo began to believe in love.

…
